name: mcp-kicad
description: Design KiCad schematics by talking to Claude: places parts, wires nets and runs KiCad's own ERC.
long_description: Describe a circuit in plain language and get back a real `.kicad_sch` file you can open and edit in KiCad. Every generated schematic is verified before you see it: no wire crosses a foreign net, no wire runs through a component body, every declared connection exists and no accidental ones do. Connections that cannot be drawn cleanly become net labels rather than wires that lie. Requires KiCad 10 installed; `kicad-cli` is detected automatically. Schematics only — no PCB layout or Gerbers.
